name: The Bloodsail Buccaneers
summary: Recovered correspondence from the Bloodsail Buccaneers carries a map of Booty Bay and written orders to secure a quiet camp at the marked spot and wait for a signal from their southern command post before attacking.

sections.title: A Plot Revealed
sections.body: Following your earlier investigation into the Bloodsail Buccaneers, an intercepted map and written orders uncover the pirates' immediate plans. A red X on a map of Booty Bay marks the exact spot where the pirates are to make camp. The orders command the crew to hold their ground quietly, eliminate anyone who approaches, and await an attack signal sent from the southern command post.

sections.title: Reporting to the Harbor
sections.body: Carrying these written findings back to Booty Bay brings the intelligence directly to First Mate Crazz, who originally sent you out to scout. The pirates are plainly waiting on a signal before they attack.

faq.q: What is written on the Bloodsail correspondence?
faq.answer: The text directs pirate crewmen to secure a quiet camp at the marked location, slay anyone who nears them, and wait for a signal from their southern command post to launch their assault.

aliases: what does the red x mean
faq.answer: The captured map of Booty Bay has a red X on it, and that is where the pirates mean to set up their camp.

faq.q: Who needs to hear about this discovery?
aliases: who do i turn this in to
faq.answer: The intelligence must be reported directly to First Mate Crazz in Booty Bay, who remembers sending you to scout the area.

faq.q: What came before finding this correspondence?
faq.answer: This investigation directly follows the initial assignment regarding the Bloodsail Buccaneers given by First Mate Crazz in Booty Bay.
